title: Who Holds the Kill Switch?
subtitle: RBI’s 24 June 2026 draft Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management is still a draft on 3 October. A CFO must inventory, validate, and be able to stop every model — including the vendor’s.
category: Model Risk, AI Governance and CFO Controls
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 3 October 2026. Primary source: RBI press release 2026-2027/528, 24 June 2026, draft Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, Brij Raj, CGM. Comments by 24 July 2026. Builds on 5 August 2024 credit-model draft and FREE-AI report of 13 August 2025. Applies to banks, NBFCs, co-operative banks, ARCs, CICs; includes third-party and AI/ML models. Composite firm: Mahanadi Finance Ltd. Composite CFO: Leela Patnaik.
thumbnail: WHO HOLDS THE KILL SWITCH? IF YOU CANNOT DETECT, CONTAIN AND EXPLAIN THE MODEL, DO NOT SIGN.
